mapper.sql: converter_id, converter_port, converter_sn, converter_ip, rod_id, converter_creator, converter_createtime, converter_updatetime, converter_status
c.converter_id, c.converter_port, c.converter_sn, c.converter_ip, c.rod_id, c.converter_creator, c.converter_createtime, c.converter_updatetime, c.converter_status, r.rod_name as rodName
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM biz_converter c LEFT JOIN biz_lifting_rod r ON c.rod_id = r.rod_id WHERE 1=1
AND c.rod_id = #{form.rodId}
AND c.converter_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.converterSn}, '%')
AND c.converter_status = 0
ORDER BY c.converter_createtime DESC
